retraction.reason: Retracted in M22: the import brought this item with no label in English or Portuguese, no description and no article in any language — nothing but the date 9 July 1998 and a European region. Nothing can be said about it, so nothing can be argued from it. The date is the day of the Faial earthquake, which the import also brought separately; whether they are the same thing cannot be established from the item.
